sources.title: GitHub - RLinf/RLinf: RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for ...
sources.snippet: RLinf is a flexible and scalable open-source RL infrastructure designed for Embodied and Agentic AI. The 'inf' in RLinf stands for Infrastructure, highlighting its role as a robust backbone for next-generation training. It also stands for Infinite, symbolizing the system's support for open-ended learning, continuous generalization, and limitless possibilities in intelligence development.
